caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular metal grate with parallel bars and a handle, shown from multiple perspectives. The main object occupies the bottom portion of the drawing, illustrated in a three-quarter view, displaying nine uniformly spaced bars within a rectangular frame. A solid horizontal base forms one end of the grate and extends into a single-looped handle. In the top right corner, a top-down view of the grate presents the same configuration of bars and handle, emphasizing their alignment and proportions. Toward the upper left, a cross-sectional side view of one bar highlights its U-shaped profile and attachment to the frame. Below this cross-section, a side elevation view shows the grate raised at a slight angle with small supporting legs. A simple linear scale appears beneath this side view. The drawing is rendered in grayscale pencil on slightly yellowed paper, titled with the name "JANET RIZA" in the lower right corner. The overall composition is organized and technical, with each view enclosed within a penciled rectangular border.
title: Flat Iron Holder
